title: Identification and experimental validation of biomarkers associated with paraptosis in meningioma.
authors: Li, Haotian; Ding, Ruiwen; Zheng, Yu; Wang, Dawen; Deng, Tingzhen; Wu, Zhi; Li, Lichao; Ma, Xingyuan; Cheng, Chenhang; Zhang, Yuhang; Luo, Yicheng; Zhang, Hengwen; Chen, Yueyang; Yu, Yue; Hou, Wei; Ding, Tao; Xie, Min; Bai, Xiaomin; Yang, Haijun; Wang, Yatao; Zheng, Maohua
one_liner_zh: 该文通过转录组数据筛选脑膜瘤副凋亡相关生物标志物，虽含分子对接和转录因子预测，但核心是表达差异与临床标志物，缺乏TF-DNA结合建模与AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Research suggests that programmed cell death may play a key role in meningioma, yet the mechanisms involving paraptosis-related genes (PRGs) remain unclear. This study aimed to identify biomarkers for meningioma that were associated with PRGs, providing new targets and strategies for therapeutic intervention. Meningioma-related datasets (GSE43290 and GSE77259) were retrieved from public databases. Initially, candidate genes were identified by overlapping PRGs with differentially expressed genes (tumor vs control). Biomarkers were then ascertained through protein-protein interaction (PPI) analysis and gene expression analysis. To further investigate the biological mechanisms of these biomarkers, functional enrichment, regulatory network, drug prediction, molecular docking, and reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction analyses were conducted. The design and implementation of this study strictly adhered to internationally recognized research standards and relevant regulations: Clinical procedures and sample collection complied with the Declaration of Helsinki, Chinese medical regulations, and the ethical review standards of the First Hospital of Lanzhou University. Data management followed GDPR requirements for anonymization and storage. The study identified ITPR3, MAPK1, and MAPK8 as biomarkers for meningioma. ITPR3 was found to be upregulated in tumor samples, while MAPK1 and MAPK8 exhibited significantly reduced expression in tumor samples. Meanwhile, reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction analysis confirmed these findings. Evidently, biomarkers were predominantly enriched in the "olfactory transduction" pathway. Regulatory network analysis predicted 130, 138, and 123 transcription factors targeting ITPR3, MAPK1, and MAPK8, respectively. Notably, SMAD3 was found to co-target all 3 biomarkers. Additionally, interactions involving MAPK1-"hsa-miR-130a-3p"-MIR17HG, MAPK8-"hsa-miR-32-5p"-NORAD, and ITPR3-"hsa-miR-506-3p"-MALAT1 were identified. Furthermore, drug prediction analysis suggested that tamoxifen could co-target these 3 biomarkers, with ITPR3 and tamoxifen exhibiting the strongest binding energy of -9.0 kcal/mol. ITPR3, MAPK1, and MAPK8 are biomarkers for meningioma, all targeted by SMAD3. Tamoxifen could treat meningioma by affecting paraptosis pathways, offering a promising basis for targeted therapy development.
abstract_zh: 研究表明，程序性细胞死亡可能在脑膜瘤中发挥关键作用，然而涉及副凋亡相关基因（PRGs）的机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在识别与PRGs相关的脑膜瘤生物标志物，为治疗干预提供新靶点和策略。从公共数据库获取了脑膜瘤相关数据集（GSE43290和GSE77259）。首先，通过将PRGs与差异表达基因（肿瘤对照）重叠来识别候选基因。随后，通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析和基因表达分析确定生物标志物。为进一步探究这些生物标志物的生物学机制，进行了功能富集、调控网络、药物预测、分子对接和逆转录定量聚合酶链反应分析。本研究的设计和实施严格遵守国际公认的研究标准和相关法规：临床程序和样本采集符合《赫尔辛基宣言》、中国医疗法规及兰州大学第一医院伦理审查标准。数据管理遵循GDPR对匿名化和存储的要求。研究确定ITPR3、MAPK1和MAPK8为脑膜瘤的生物标志物。发现ITPR3在肿瘤样本中上调，而MAPK1和MAPK8在肿瘤样本中表达显著降低。同时，逆转录定量聚合酶链反应分析证实了这些发现。显然，生物标志物主要富集在“嗅觉转导”通路中。调控网络分析预测分别有130、138和123个转录因子靶向ITPR3、MAPK1和MAPK8。值得注意的是，发现SMAD3共同靶向所有3个生物标志物。此外，识别了涉及MAPK1-“hsa-miR-130a-3p”-MIR17HG、MAPK8-“hsa-miR-32-5p”-NORAD和ITPR3-“hsa-miR-506-3p”-MALAT1的相互作用。进一步地，药物预测分析提示他莫昔芬可共同靶向这3个生物标志物，其中ITPR3与他莫昔芬结合能最强，为-9.0 kcal/mol。ITPR3、MAPK1和MAPK8是脑膜瘤的生物标志物，均受SMAD3靶向调控。他莫昔芬可能通过影响副凋亡通路治疗脑膜瘤，为靶向治疗开发提供了有前景的基础。
